Title: Azure Data Factory is now available in five new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory is now available in five new regions:

  • Switzerland North 
  • Japan West 
  • Canada East 
  • Germany West Central 
  • UK West 

You can now provision Data Factory, Azure Integration Runtime, and SSIS Integration Runtime in these new regions in order to co-locate your ETL logic with your data lake and compute.  You can also use these regions for BCDR purposes in case you need to failover from another region within the geo.
